title: Julius B. Richmond FAMRI Professor of Child Health and Development Professor of Pediatrics, HMS and Boston Children's Hospital
bio: As director of the Center on the Developing Child, Jack P. Shonkoff, M.D., is using the science of early childhood development to drive innovation in policy and practice, with the goal of transforming life outcomes for disadvantaged children and reducing the consequences of early adversity.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
